tree.heading: General Authority.—
tree.text: The Secretary may lease quarters at or near a System unit for use as seasonal quarters for field employees if the Secretary finds that there is a shortage of adequate and affordable seasonal quarters at or near the System unit and that—

children.text: the requirement for the seasonal field employee quarters is temporary; or
leasing would be more cost-effective than construction of new seasonal field employee quarters.

tree.heading: Rent.—
tree.text: The rent charged to field employees under the lease shall be a rate based on the reasonable value of the quarters in accordance with requirements applicable under section 5911 of title 5.

tree.heading: Unrecovered Costs.—
tree.text: The Secretary may pay the unrecovered costs of leasing seasonal quarters under this section from annual appropriations for the year in which the lease is made.
